points: \item Implemented a self-correcting RAG system using LangChain and Mistral 7B for computational drug discovery pipelines, improving document QA accuracy by ~20% and enabling reliable knowledge extraction from biomedical literature.

\item Built a hybrid retrieval workflow combining dense embeddings (FAISS) with BM25 search, enhancing relevance and coverage of retrieved scientific documents for scalable drug discovery platform infrastructure.

\item Developed LLM-as-Judge evaluation pipeline to assess faithfulness and relevance across hundreds of QA examples, ensuring production-ready reliability and robust validation for machine learning workflows at scale.

\item Introduced batched query extraction using PyTorch, reducing LLM calls by ~80% per query and enabling faster, efficient production inference for data processing and model training in biotechnology applications.

\item Designed ML-based anomaly detection system for MFA workflows, reducing redundant verification prompts by 25% while maintaining security coverage and improving system efficiency in computational platforms.

\item Built a multi-agent research workflow using CrewAI with PubMed retrieval via Model Context Protocol, enabling interactive biomedical QA and supporting computational scientists in world-class drug discovery pipelines.
